messages.subject: iid3d model
parts:
Hello all,

Assuming the following syntax:

... + f(randomEffect1, ContinuousVar1 ,model="iid3d", n= 3*21) + f(randomEffect2, ContinuousVar2 , copy= "randomEffect1") + f(randomEffect3, ContinuousVar3, copy= "randomEffect1")

where 

randomEffect2 = randomEffect1 + 21
randomEffect3 = randomEffect2 + 21

ContinuousVar1 , ContinuousVar2, ContinuousVar3 are continuous variables included as fixed effects.

Could you confirm if I am right?:

1- The parameter "n" in the model "iid3d" is calculated by multiplying the number of the levels of the random factor (ie, 21) by 3.

2- The output of model$summary.random$randomfactor1$mean gives the random slopes of the three continuous variables across the levels of the random effect.

3- Why the output of #2- is repeated in model$summary.random$randomfactor2$mean and model$summary.random$randomfactor3$mean ?

Thank you in advance!

Best

Juanmi
